title: Settled Elements in Arboreal Galois Groups of Quadratic PCF Polynomials
summary: Let $f(x) \in K(x)$ be a quadratic polynomial where $K$ is a field of characteristic not equal to $2$. The associated arboreal Galois representation of the absolute Galois group of $K$ acts on a regular rooted binary tree. Boston and Jones conjectured that, for $f \in \mathbb{Z}[x]$, the image of this representation contains a dense set of settled elements.
